title: Network Signal Field Contract v1
description: Evidence-gated temporal signals for companies, listings, industries and other network objects. Display configuration is not a measured fact.

available_time.description: Earliest time the local model could use the record.

expires_time.description: Optional exclusive end of signal visibility.

signal_event_evidence.csv.description: Independent evidence with raw_numeric_value, raw_unit and raw_text kept separate from normalized display strength. Missing quantities remain null with an explicit not_reported unit.

cycle_policy.description: Keep the maximum absolute path per event and object.
